rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 8 September 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 Hong Kong — HKMA is consulting on a Phase 2B sustainable-finance taxonomy prototype; affected lending, investment and sustainability-claim governance teams can consider the implications and any comments before 7 October 2026. • 🟡 Hong Kong — SFC expects licensed corporations, licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities to update customer- and payment-screening databases for two UN sanctions-list amendments. Hong Kong 🟡 HKMA consults on Phase 2B Hong Kong Taxonomy prototype 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260907-hkma-press-fc293c82d1 ⏰ Deadline: 7 October 2026 (consultation comments) Products: Lending, Investment, Marketing The HKMA has opened a public consultation on the Phase 2B prototype of the Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance. The prototype adds 10 economic activities, taking the total from 25 to 39, and includes technical criteria for green and transition activities and a process-based climate-adaptation approach. Comments are invited on or before 7 October 2026. This is a consultation rather than a final taxonomy requirement; the final scope, applicability and adoption timing remain undecided. Source: HKMA launches public consultation on Phase 2B prototype of Hong Kong Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance 🟡 SFC early alert on UN sanctions-list amendments 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260907-sfc-aml-circulars-57f197b1d4 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investment, Payments, Digital The SFC alerts licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual-asset service providers and associated entities to amendments made to two individual entries on the UN Security Council committee’s ISIL (Da’esh) and Al-Qaida sanctions list. It expects those entities to update customer- and payment-screening databases, with reference to the SFC’s 2018 circular on expected regulatory standards. An updated list under section 25 of Cap. 537CB was published on 6 September 2026, and the SFC says the entities will be alerted when the Cap. 575 list is gazetted. The alert expresses a supervisory expectation for its named perimeter and does not evidence a new prudential rule for authorised institutions generally. Source: Circular to Licensed Corporations, SFC-licensed Virtual Asset Service Providers and Associated Entities — Anti-Money Laundering / Counter-Financing of Terrorism — Early Alert on United Nations Sanctions Mainland/GBA No current-run items. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No current-run items. Watch List • Monitor the HKMA consultation outcome and any subsequent Phase 2B finalisation. • Monitor for the Cap. 575 sanctions-list Gazette update that the SFC says it will alert entities about.
